features.quote: Hard cap: 25 tool calls per run
features.justification_quote: Don't let transcripts grow so long that the model is failing due to context pressure rather than loop dynamics.

features.quote: If a run hits Type C abandonment (model stops tool use and outputs terminal apology), end the run. Don't burn tokens on 20 more empty turns.
features.justification_quote: Don't burn tokens on 20 more empty turns. This requires detecting terminal outputs in your harness, not just the judge.
